description: Machine premises (TX12, D-070): values a test or the session identity needs before any session state exists. A bootstrap owner (config.bootstrap_owners): config.get returns the registry value and never reads the shared change store, so a store without token, rate-limited or with an empty cache never decides them.

env-premises.probe_timeout_s.description: How long a test's machine-premise probe may take (the dropped uid running the interpreter, sudo -n true, env.sh placing a shim guard) before the premise counts as not holding.

env-premises.session_id_ceiling.description: First uid/gid the session identity never uses (exclusive); from it up are ordinary host accounts.

env-premises.session_id_floor.description: Lowest uid/gid the session identity creates for a missing user (inclusive); below it are system accounts.
